openings.claim: A pencilled pattern ledger may prevent omissions: copy specified quantities and dimensions, mark only after counted placement, and compare contents before closing. Retain trays and samples; check during assembly.
openings.discriminator: Missing contents beside completed lines defeat the placement safeguard; staging improvement without ledger improvement challenges its main causal advantage.
openings.probe: Alternate matched-pattern blocks: incumbent, shared trays with ledger, and local staging without ledger. Audit contents; count setup, copying, filling, checking, correction time and crossing reaches.
openings.uncertainty: Samples may not expose every specification; whether omissions arise in picking or filling remains unknown. Writing and checking overhead is unverified.

openings.claim: Leave assigned pattern identifiers visible on envelopes to support distribution without opening them.
openings.discriminator: Assignment errors despite visible correct identifiers challenge this separate benefit.
openings.probe: Record assignment errors and exchanges at distribution.
openings.uncertainty: The synthetic exchanges establish a problem, not a tested labeling effect.

openings.claim: Local loose materials may reduce shared-picking interference and omissions independently of ledgers.
openings.discriminator: Matched-mixture staging outperforming correctly used shared-tray ledgers supports the rival explanation.
openings.probe: Use the matched comparison above, alternating order and recording crossings.
openings.uncertainty: The omission-free small batch has unknown pattern mixture. Opened-packet area and full-run transfer remain unknown.

lineage.reason: Retains ledger, assignment labeling and staging rival with their discriminators.
Adds placement failures, dimensions, overhead and supply uncertainties.

decision: Probe before adoption. Preserve specified quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, at most 90 minutes, the 180-by-75-centimetre table and existing envelopes/supplies; no purchases. Verify layouts and sufficient specified materials: one reserve packet does not prove adequacy. Small-batch success requires a subsequent 60-kit run within 90 minutes with at most one distribution correction. All evidence is synthetic; no effect is demonstrated.
